en-us.Recreation_GatherFailed_nobody: Half an hour past the agreed time, and nobody has come for the $activityName$ - it is called off.
en-us.Recreation_GatherFailed_Stay_waited: $waited.name$ waited half an hour, but $late.name$ never came - the $activityName$ is called off.
en-us.Recreation_GatherFailed_Stay_late: By the time $late.name$ arrived, the $activityName$ had long been called off.
en-us.Recreation_GatherFailed_Leave_waited: $waited.name$ waited half an hour, but $late.name$ never came, so they left.
en-us.Recreation_GatherFailed_Leave_late: $late.name$ arrived far too late - the $activityName$ had been called off, and everyone who waited had already left.
en-us.Recreation_MediaSession_Begin_late: $joining.name$ quietly joined the $activityName$ already under way.
